subject: sd operation not working in transformed parameters block in 2.0.1

messages.author: c6823c7fe297889f
messages.subject: sd operation not working in transformed parameters block in 2.0.1
parts:
I have fairly simple linear error-in-variables model which was working properly in rstan 1.3, but now does not work in 2.0.1. It appears that the problem is with the sd operation. In the model I standardize the modeled predictor in the transformed parameters block to a mean 0 and sd 1. I do this in the transformed parameters block (as opposed to the transformed data block) because the true values of these variable are being modeled at each step, and therefore change slightly at each iteration. When I run the model as previously written I get the error:

Error : Posterior is improper. Please check your model.
error occurred during calling the sampler; sampling not done

After toying with things I discovered that if I remove the line in my code  where I calculate sd in the the transformed parameters block, and just replace it with a hard coded value, everything works fine. As I said, this does not seem to cause any problem in 1.3, so I am wondering if this might be a bug in 2.0.1. Here is a simplified version of the model:

#STAN model
model <- "
data{
  int<lower = 0> N;
  int<lower = 0> Ngenus;
  vector[N] y;
  vector[Ngenus] xobs;
  vector[Ngenus] sigx;
  int<lower = 0> genus[N];
}

parameters{
  vector[Ngenus] xtru;
  real alpha;
  real beta;
  real<lower = 0, upper = 100> sigma[Ngenus];
}

transformed parameters{
  real meanxtru;
  real sdxtru;
  vector[Ngenus] xtru2;
  vector[N] mu;
  vector[N] sigmavec; 

  meanxtru <- mean(xtru);
  sdxtru <- sd(xtru); ////////////This line seems to be causing the problem////////////////
  for (i in 1:Ngenus)
    xtru2[i] <- (xtru[i] - meanxtru)/sdxtru; //scale x

  for (i in 1:N){
    sigmavec[i] <- sigma[genus[i]]; //vectorize of sigma for model block
    mu[i] <- alpha + beta*xtru2[genus[i]];
  }
}

model{
  xobs ~ normal(xtru,sigx); 
  xtru ~ normal(0,1000);

  alpha ~ normal(0, 1000);
  beta ~ normal(0, 1000);

  y ~ normal(mu, sigmavec);
}
"

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] sd operation not working in transformed parameters block in 2.0.1
parts:
Thanks for the report. That's indeed a bug.
Here's a minimal example:

parameters {
vector[5] y;
}
transformed parameters {
real sd_y;
sd_y <- sd(y);
}
model {
y ~ normal(0,1);
}

We'll fix it in the next release. Here's the issue to track
progress:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/379

- Bob
